nl: 订阅套餐管理：查询有套餐名称、价格；表格展示套餐名称、价格、自动续费、续费折扣、到期提醒语；支持新增、编辑、删除。表单里「续费折扣」只在开启自动续费时才显示，「到期提醒语」则在开启自动续费时隐藏。
nlEn: Subscription plan management: query by plan name and price; the table shows plan name, price, auto-renew, renewal discount, and expiry notice; supports add, edit, and delete. In the form, "renewal discount" is only shown when auto-renew is on, while "expiry notice" is hidden when auto-renew is on.
notes: AI-06: isHidden op=truthy/falsy — 同一开关字段驱动两个字段的反相显隐（vue3/schema）
